$comment: Reënbui (GDD §11.3e, D-067): the first summer rain and the flying ants. A world event of its own (stream `reenbui`), at most once a hunt, by a chance per area; a layout's `reenbui` forces or forbids it, a calm day never has it. Px are design px at the mid plane (D-049), times in seconds. In a Kalahari omen hunt the swarm rises when the Donderstorm breaks (no build-up or drops of its own); in an Okavango omen hunt the sun-shower spells that would overlap it are dropped. columns.planes: a plane listed twice is twice as likely.
